newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NatSteel to raise US$190 million.
newsitem.headline: NatSteel to raise US$190 million.

text.p: NatSteel Ltd said on Monday it proposed to raise up to US$190 million through an issue of redeemable convertible cumulative preference shares (RCCPS).
The diversified steel company said proceeds will be used to repay existing loans, for working capital and for future investments.
About US$85 million will be used to finance the possible investment in Aco Minas Gerais S.A. (Acominas), a steel manufacturer in Brazil, it said in a company statement.
It added that if the investment in Acominas does not go through, the balance of funds will be chanelled to repay loans, for working capital and for future investments.
Investment in Acominas will strengthen and complement the group's steel business in Asia. The move will assist NatSteel in securing high quality feedstock at competitive prices, the statement said.
The propose issue is subject to shareholders approval.
